relations: Right hand gripping the disc rim tilts it, shifting specular highlights and altering its apparent elliptical shape.
When the grip opens, fingers spread along the top rim while the thumb supports the lower edge.
The left hand rises closer to the disc, remaining blurred from motion as handling continues.
The framed cat photo and paper corner remain nearly fixed behind the reorienting disc.
caption: A right hand grips the rim of a gold optical disc and holds it upright above a reflective glass tabletop. The disc bears faint TDK lettering and small printed dots that shift in and out of clear view as it turns. The hand continuously tilts and reorients the disc, changing its apparent shape from a broad ellipse to a narrower slanted ellipse. Warm specular highlights move across the shiny surface, with a bright vertical band giving way to rainbow iridescent streaks. Later, the grip opens, with fingers spread along the top rim while the thumb supports the lower edge. A left hand stays partly visible at the lower-left edge, then rises closer to the disc, remaining blurred from motion. Behind the disc, a framed photograph of a resting cat and a pale paper corner remain in nearly fixed positions. The handling process continues, with the disc’s angle, reflections, and grip shifting steadily.
